title: Plutonic
summary: PLUTON'IC, adjective [from Pluto, in mythology, the king of the infernal regions.] Pertaining to or designating the system of the Plutonists; as the plutonic theory.

inlines.v: PLUTON'IC, adjective [from Pluto, in mythology, the king of the infernal regions.] Pertaining to or designating the system of the Plutonists; as the plutonic theory.
